kept.heading: INSTAGRAM PUTS NEW LIMITS ON UNDISCLOSED AI PROFILES (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Instagram is renaming its “AI creator” label to “AI-generated profile” to make it clearer when an account features a fully AI-generated person. It will also limit recommendations for unlabeled AI profiles, while creators who proactively disclose their AI identity won't see a reach penalty. The change targets transparency around AI personas, not creators who use AI tools in their content workflow.

kept.heading: MUSIC LICENSING CLAIMS ARE COMING FOR MARKETERS (6 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Music licensing claims are becoming a growing risk as brands and influencers use copyrighted content without proper clearance. Old social posts can also create exposure when licensing records are missing. Brands need to audit existing content and ensure influencer agreements cover licensing responsibilities.

kept.heading: WHAT MAKES A GOOD LISTICLE? (6 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Freshness is the strongest ranking signal for listicles, so keep dates recent and easy for search engines to interpret. Explicit list counts also tend to perform better, with larger numbers often ranking higher. By contrast, word count, images, author bios, schema markup, and extra headings don't reliably improve rankings. Self-promotional listicles can still perform well, but putting your own product first doesn't appear to drive that growth.

kept.heading: MYOG.SOCIAL (TOOL)
kept.blurb: MyOG.social is an Open Graph checker and branded social card generator. The website offers a free URL checker to spot issues, and the paid tool automatically fixes broken social cards via a one-tag implementation.

kept.heading: OPENAI LOOKS TO STREAMLINE CHATGPT AD CAMPAIGN CREATION (3 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: OpenAI is making it faster to launch ChatGPT ad campaigns with a redesigned onboarding flow that can build a campaign in under 60 seconds. Users can enter their website, and AI will analyze their business, suggest relevant ChatGPT user journeys, and generate ad creative and copy. OpenAI is also offering new advertisers $500 in matching ad credits.

kept.heading: GOOGLE SHOPPING TAB LETS USERS FILTER PRODUCTS BY TRUSTED REVIEW SITES (1 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Google is testing a new mobile Shopping filter that lets users narrow product results by review source. The “Top Reviewed in 2026” filter includes sites such as YouTube and Reddit, making it easier for shoppers to prioritize reviews from sources they trust.

kept.heading: NO AI, NO UPLOADS, NO ADS: DIVINE'S CEO SAYS FRICTION COULD SAVE SOCIAL MEDIA (5 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Divine, the app reviving Vine, bans AI content and requires videos to be filmed and verified live on-device. With no ads or algorithmic feed, it's betting that authenticity and familiar faces will matter more as AI floods social media with content.

kept.heading: THE NEXT ERA OF MARKETING MAY BE A LOT SMALLER THAN YOU THINK (3 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Marketing is moving away from mass reach and toward smaller, high-trust audiences. Brands like Urban Outfitters and Tracksuit are prioritizing participation and niche creators over follower counts, while Charli XCX is building intimate fan experiences before going mass. Deep audience relationships are becoming more valuable than sheer scale.

kept.heading: META IS PUTTING HARD LIMITS ON FACEBOOK AND INSTAGRAM AFTER $17 BILLION SETTLEMENT (3 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Instagram and Facebook will default minors to 2 hours of daily use, with overnight access blocked and school-hour notifications muted.

kept.heading: GOOGLE AI OVERVIEWS PUSHING SEARCHERS INTO AI MODE, DROPS SHOW MORE BUTTON (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Google is expanding AI Overviews for some queries, showing a fuller AI answer and the “Ask anything” box by default instead of requiring users to click “Show more”. This pushes traditional organic results further down the page, giving publishers and SEOs less visibility while Google steers more searches toward AI Mode.

kept.heading: FTC SUES AMAZON, ACCUSING THE E-COMMERCE GIANT OF MISLEADING ADVERTISERS (3 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: The FTC and 22 state attorneys general sued Amazon on Monday, alleging it secretly overcharged advertisers by more than $20 billion through hidden auction surcharges dating back to a 2019 rule change. Amazon had told advertisers its second-price auction system only charged the minimum bid needed to win, but the FTC says Amazon quietly added an undisclosed "soft reserve price" that pushed costs higher. Amazon calls the lawsuit misguided and says its auction system saved advertisers $8 billion between 2021 and 2025, with a trial set to test which version holds up.

kept.heading: HOW WE'D MARKET A $400 SKINCARE DEVICE BEFORE BLACK FRIDAY (7 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Black Friday marketing starts well before the sale for high-consideration products. SparkToro's research found LED skincare shoppers spend months comparing products, reading reviews, and researching results. They use search, AI tools, YouTube, Reddit, and beauty publications. Brands can use this research phase to answer key questions and influence buying decisions early. That way, BFCM campaigns can focus on converting shoppers instead of introducing the product.

kept.heading: THE PAGES YOUR AGENCY BUILT TO WIN AI CITATIONS JUST LOST HALF OF THEM (3 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: ChatGPT and Google are reducing visibility for the listicles and comparison pages that have powered many agency AI visibility programs since 2024. ChatGPT citations for listicles fell 50.5%, from 15.77% to 7.80%, after its August 6 update, while product pages rose to 16.39% of retrieved pages. Brands should audit citation performance by page type and invest more in primary product and pricing pages that provide specifications and real information directly on the vendor's domain. AI visibility now favors useful source material over pages built mainly to match "best," "top," or "vs" queries.

kept.heading: MEET @ARCHIE (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Archive's Archie is an AI agent for creator sourcing in Slack or Teams. Tag @archie with a campaign brief, and it finds creators across platforms. It vets each candidate for brand safety, competitor conflicts, posting consistency, and bot patterns. You get a pre-checked list of creators ready for outreach. Archie is currently invite-only, with a waitlist open for access.

kept.heading: HOW TO SCALE, SELL & SPEND MORE THIS Q4 (WEBINAR)
kept.blurb: This live masterclass will cover how to expand channels ahead of Black Friday and Cyber Monday to drive sales. Speakers from Ridge, HexClad, AppLovin, and Haus will share strategies for holiday gift campaigns, acquiring new customers, and measuring incrementality. It's happening September 10 from 4-5 PM EST and will include a step-by-step channel expansion playbook.

kept.heading: THE STORE ISN'T DEAD—BUT THE MERCHANT MODEL IS (8 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: More than 7,300 US stores closed last year, the most since 2020, while store openings held just as strong, evidence that retail formats are evolving rather than physical stores disappearing. The actual weak point is the merchant model, which has retailers forecasting demand and owning inventory months before they know if it will sell. A growing number of retailers are shifting to a store-in-store setup instead, renting curated space to brands that carry their own inventory risk, the way Harrods lets luxury labels run their own sections and set their own prices. AI shopping agents are pushing the shift further, since faster demand swings raise the cost of the merchant model's forecasting bets.

kept.heading: SHOW THE COST OF EACH AI PROMPT (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Showing users the cost or remaining capacity of each AI prompt can lead to more intentional usage and better outcomes. Researchers analyzed 1.8M+ prompts from 61,000+ users and found that users spent 5% more time refining prompts and 8% less time generating duplicate image variants when usage costs were visible. AI products should make consumption easier to understand by showing prompt costs, token usage, or remaining prompts instead of abstract quotas. Teams using AI should also expose usage limits so employees make more deliberate choices about when and how they prompt.

kept.heading: AFFILIATE HAS OUTGROWN THE BOTTOM OF THE FUNNEL (5 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Affiliate marketing is undergoing four major shifts: it must influence customers before they are ready to buy, trust matters more than traffic alone, creator and affiliate strategies need to operate as one partnership strategy, and measurement must extend beyond last click. Brands should expand partner programs beyond coupon and cashback sites to include publishers, comparison sites, reviewers, and creators that shape discovery and consideration. They also need broader measurement and shared data to value influence across the full customer journey. These changes position affiliate as a growth strategy that helps create demand, not just capture existing demand.

kept.heading: AMID GROWING AI DISTRUST, HUMANITY TAKES A FRONT SEAT IN ADVERTISING (4 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: The growing backlash against AI is prompting brands to make humanity itself a central theme in advertising, either through explicit messaging or more tactile, imperfect creative. Tech brands such as Anthropic and Meta are using optimistic narratives to address concerns about AI, while brands such as Polaroid, Pinterest, and Heineken are encouraging consumers to reconnect with the physical world. Brands can reinforce this positioning through film, handmade aesthetics, natural elements, and behind-the-scenes content that shows real people creating the work. The strategy works best when humanity reflects a genuine point of view rather than becoming another empty brand buzzword.

kept.heading: YOUTUBE AEO GUIDE: HOW TO DOMINATE AI SEARCH WITH YOUTUBE (7 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: YouTube now draws roughly 200x more AI citations than any other platform, and its share of social citations 4x in four months to overtake Reddit as the top-cited social source in Q1 2026. Automatic transcripts are the core driver, turning every explainer video into a searchable text document AI models can parse directly instead of relying on tags or descriptions alone. That citation strength concentrates almost entirely in long-form video, since AI models weight depth and comprehensive topic coverage that Shorts aren't built to carry.

kept.heading: HOW TO MAKE LINKEDIN CAROUSELS PEOPLE ACTUALLY STOP FOR (WEBINAR)
kept.blurb: This free webinar will break down how to create LinkedIn carousels that keep people reading. Amy Watts will share what's working on LinkedIn now and the framework she uses to create 10 carousels a week. She'll also roast a few carousels live. It's happening on September 8 at 9 AM EDT.

kept.heading: TRY GOOGLE PICS: EASY IMAGE CREATION AND EDITING IN GOOGLE WORKSPACE (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Google Pics is an AI image creation and editing tool powered by Google's Nano Banana model. It can generate graphics, edit specific objects, and change text within images. It also creates multiple versions from one prompt. Pics is rolling out to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers and most Workspace business customers. It will also integrate with Docs, Slides, and Drive.

kept.heading: HOW TO FIND AND PITCH REAL CASE STUDIES FOR DIGITAL PR WITH BECCA PEEL (11 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Case studies are becoming a critical part of digital PR because journalists need real people who can make data credible, relevant, and harder to replicate with AI. PR teams should start with their own networks, then verify each person through signals such as LinkedIn, business listings, websites, and direct calls before pitching. Strong case studies offer a genuinely new insight, connect directly to the campaign data, and give journalists an exclusive human angle they cannot simply find through Google.

kept.heading: HOW E.L.F. BEAUTY IS BUILDING AI INTO ITS COMMUNITY MANAGEMENT (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: E.l.f. Beauty's AI reply tool, E.l.f.luencer, is trained on the brand's own stylebook and years of past community-manager responses to answer social comments automatically, with every reply still reviewed by a human before it posts. The tool now generates 90% of the brand's TikTok and Instagram replies in E.l.f.'s specific tone, language, and emoji use, pushing the response rate from 30-40% before launch to more than 80% now. That volume would be impossible for a manual team to match, and the same AI investment underpins a broader program of 85 agentic pilots the company is moving toward full production.

kept.heading: OPENAI'S ASTRA MODEL IS ON THE WAY—AND VERY GOOD AT BREAKING INTO COMPUTER SYSTEMS (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Astra scored a perfect score on ExploitBench, an evaluation of an LLM's ability to hack into known system vulnerabilities.
